summary: Pocahontas County, WV 30-foot steel lookout built 1928 on the Monongahela NF, staffed until 1950; only footers remain, reached by a hiking loop from WV 28.

facts.status_note: Only the concrete footers remain at the summit; the steel tower is gone

access.note: Reached on foot on Monongahela National Forest land; a hiking guide says there is no parking at the site itself

visit.trail_note: 4.2-mile loop from WV Route 28 by the Smoke Camp Trail, with the Rothkugel Loop interpretive trail; parking for two or three cars off WV 28 per the guide

events.note: Earlier tree-stand tower, per a register photo caption

notes_for_editor: The register and Forest Lookouts agree on 1928 and last staffing in 1950. The hiking guide is the only source for what is at the site now, and it says parking is nonexistent on site, and gives room for two or three cars on Forest Service Road 54 off WV 28 (it names FR 58 for the forest road up the mountain). Check current access with the Monongahela NF Greenbrier Ranger District before publishing visit advice. The record's 9.1 m height matches the 30-foot figure. The register photos are already in the record, so no new photos were added.
